note: Context diagnostics + reflection order (P1-F): the chat screen asks the chat Retrieval to put the AI's diary reflections after the user's own records (deferReflections; Connect and every other caller keep the old order), and only with ?debugLog=1 builds the per-route provenance of what it sends (chatContextProvenance.ts; kept in the tab's memory only, never stored or sent elsewhere). The chat route labels a reflection as the AI's diary text, adds the order of the material for questions about the user's own past (only with past context), and only with debugGenerationId adds the provenance of what it accepted to the debug envelope. Without the debug the reply and the prompt are the same either way.
